official.deadline_note: The 2026/2027 notice required the online application and documents to be submitted in the system before February 8, 2026; the Embassy then forwarded recommended applications to the China Scholarship Council between February 9 and March 5, 2026, and that window has now closed.
official.status_note: The 2026/2027 application window closed on 8 February 2026 and results were released in the system in July-August 2026; the Embassy has published no next-cycle date.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The notice describes the award only as a 'Full scholarship' and states it 'Does not include international travel expenses'; no itemised tuition or living-cost breakdown is published.
benefits: Full scholarship (as described in the notice)
Recruitment for students going to China to study marine, medical, health, tourism, education and other required majors
Does not include international travel expenses
eligibility: Citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China, in good health both mentally and physically

Age ceilings by level: high school graduate under 25 (undergraduate), bachelor's holder under 35 (master's), master's holder under 40 (doctoral), high school graduate under 45 (general scholar), master's holder or associate professor under 50 (senior scholar)
China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report required when applying for bachelor programs

Chinese proficiency of HSK Level 3 for Chinese-taught general scholar and senior scholar programs; HSK Level 4 for Chinese-taught master's or doctoral programs (Chinese-language students exempted from the general scholar requirement)
Applicants who obtained their degree from a Chinese university using Chinese as the teaching language do not need to provide language proficiency certificates
Meet the admission requirements of the applied universities in terms of academic ability, language proficiency and other relevant criteria
requirements: Obtain Pre-Admission Documents from the chosen Chinese universities before submitting the online application
Bachelor's applicants must register for and take the CSCA before the application deadline (December 21, 2025 or January 25, 2026 for September 2026 enrolment)
Uploaded supporting documents must be clear, authentic and valid
documents: Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (in Chinese or English)
Passport home page: clear scanned copy of the information page of an ordinary passport, valid for at least 12 months from the expected start date of study

Notarised highest diploma (prospective diploma winners submit official proof of student status) and academic transcripts, with notarised Chinese or English translations where the original is not in Chinese or English

Language qualification certificates (valid HSK score report for Chinese-taught programmes; IELTS or TOEFL-type certificates for programmes taught in other languages) and the CSCA Score Report for bachelor's applicants

Pre-Admission Documents issued by the universities applied to (pre-admission notice or invitation letter from a school or professor - at least one is required), plus a Study Plan or Research Proposal in Chinese or English (minimum 200 words for undergraduates, 500 for non-degree students, 800 for postgraduates)

Supporting items: two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors for graduate or senior scholar programmes; Example of Art/Other Supporting Documents for art or design majors; valid guardians' documents in China for applicants under 18; photocopy of the completed Foreigner Physical Examination Form for stays over 6 months; non-criminal record report issued by the local public security authority usually within 6 months prior to submission
selection_criteria: The embassy sends all recommended applications to the China Scholarship Council for final review
coverage: Does not include international travel expenses
application_method: Submit the online application and the corresponding application documents in the system at www.campuschina.org before February 8, 2026, using Indonesian Agency Number 3602
There is no need to send paper materials to the embassy
official.application_route: Apply online at www.campuschina.org under Indonesian Agency Number 3602 before 8 February 2026; no paper materials go to the Embassy.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China; the programme recruits for the China-Indonesia scholarship track
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Marine, medical, health, tourism, education and other required majors (China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program, 20 places)
official.research_requirement: Study Plan or Research Proposal in Chinese or English (minimum 200 words for undergraduates, 500 words for non-degree students, 800 words for postgraduates)
official.description: The 2026/2027 Chinese Government Scholarship announced by the Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Indonesia includes the China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program with 20 places for undergraduate, master's and doctoral study, described as a full scholarship that does not include international travel expenses.
official.program_type: China - Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program (Chinese Government Scholarship)
official.english_requirement: Applicants for programmes taught in other languages are required to provide relevant language proficiency certificates, such as IELTS or TOEFL score reports, in accordance with the requirements of each university

not_confirmed: funding_amount, funding_currency and funding_period (the Embassy notice publishes no figures)
living_cost_coverage (the notice says 'full scholarship' without itemising accommodation or stipend)
verification.notes: Eligibility, documents, agency number, deadline and timetable read from the Embassy's 27 October 2025 notice; amounts left null because the notice publishes none, so fully_funded is recorded false.

applicant_utility.summary: This notice opens 20 China-Indonesia Scholarship places inside the wider Chinese Government Scholarship for undergraduate, master's and doctoral study, aimed at marine, medical, health, tourism and education fields. The critical preprocessing is a pre-admission document from your target Chinese university - without one the application cannot be filed - plus the CSCA test if you are a bachelor's applicant. Budget for your own airfare: the notice is explicit that international travel is not included, and the application runs entirely through campuschina.org under Indonesian Agency Number 3602 with nothing posted to the Embassy.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants on the China-Indonesia track (non-PRC citizens) targeting priority majors who can secure pre-admission from a Chinese university early.
application_readiness_checklist: Contact Chinese universities and secure a pre-admission notice or professor invitation before filing - at least one is mandatory
Bachelor's applicants: register for the CSCA on the fixed test dates (21 December 2025 or 25 January 2026 for a September 2026 start) and upload the score report
Check your passport has at least 12 months' validity from your study start date
Prepare notarised diploma and transcripts with notarised translations where needed
Draft the study plan to the required length (200/500/800 words by level)
File at campuschina.org with Agency Number 3602 before 8 February 2026 and verify every upload is legible
common_rejection_risks: No pre-admission document from any applied university
Bachelor's applicants without a CSCA score report
Passport validity under 12 months from the study start date
Blurry or unreadable uploads - the notice puts the consequences on the applicant
Applying outside the priority-major recruitment focus for the China-Indonesia places
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: International travel is explicitly excluded; visa costs, notarisation, translations and personal spending are also yours.
document_audit: The non-criminal record report must usually be issued within 6 months prior to submission
The Foreigner Physical Examination Form is valid for only 6 months and must cover all listed items with the physician's signature, hospital stamp and sealed photograph
Applicants under 18 need valid documents of their legal guardians in China
Chinese-taught master's and doctoral programmes require HSK 4; general scholar programmes HSK 3
alerts: Double-funding is enforced: holding other Chinese government awards cancels the CGS, and concealment brings a three-year application ban
Results only appear in the system in July-August, months after the February deadline
The Embassy does not review papers - an incomplete portal file is simply an incomplete application
The next cycle's dates are unpublished; monitor the Embassy's updates page
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Single portal file at campuschina.org before 8 February 2026; the Embassy bundles recommendations to the CSC between 9 February and 5 March, and results appear in the system in July-August.
